streams.label: Recycling
streams.description: Clean paper, cardboard, plastic bottles and containers (#1-#5), metal cans, glass bottles and jars. Items must be empty and rinsed.

streams.label: Compost
streams.description: Food scraps, fruit and vegetable peels, coffee grounds, tea bags, soiled paper napkins, paper towels, yard waste, compostable containers marked BPI-certified.

streams.label: Landfill
streams.description: Chip bags, candy wrappers, styrofoam, plastic wrap, plastic bags, lined coffee cups, straws, mixed-material packaging, broken ceramics, diapers.

streams.label: Special Disposal
streams.description: Batteries, electronics, light bulbs, medications, paint, motor oil, hazardous chemicals. Do not place in regular bins.

streams.label: Needs Verification
streams.description: Items that cannot be confidently classified. Please ask facilities staff or check the posted signage near the bins.

overrides.note: Most paper coffee cups have a plastic lining and cannot be recycled. Remove the lid and sleeve first.
overrides.note_ja: 紙コップは内側にプラスチックコーティングがあるためリサイクル不可。フタとスリーブは外してください。

overrides.note: Lined paper cups are not recyclable in most facilities.
overrides.note_ja: コーティングされた紙コップはほとんどの施設でリサイクルできません。

overrides.note: Grease-soiled cardboard is not recyclable or compostable in most facilities.
overrides.note_ja: 油汚れのある段ボールはリサイクル・コンポストできません。

overrides.note: Plastic bags jam sorting machinery. Some grocery stores accept them for separate recycling.
overrides.note_ja: ビニール袋は分別機を詰まらせます。スーパーの回収ボックスを利用してください。

overrides.note: Expanded polystyrene is not accepted in most curbside recycling programs.
overrides.note_ja: 発泡スチロールはほとんどのリサイクルプログラムで回収対象外です。

overrides.note: Batteries require special disposal. Look for a battery collection bin or take to a hazardous waste facility.
overrides.note_ja: 電池は特別処理が必要です。専用回収ボックスに入れてください。

overrides.note: Fluorescent and CFL bulbs contain mercury. LED and incandescent bulbs can go in landfill if no special collection is available.
overrides.note_ja: 蛍光灯・電球型蛍光灯は水銀を含みます。LED・白熱電球は専用回収がなければ埋立へ。

overrides.note: Used paper napkins and tissues are compostable.
overrides.note_ja: 使用済みのナプキンやティッシュはコンポスト可能です。

overrides.note: Rinse before recycling. Crushing is optional.
overrides.note_ja: 中を洗ってからリサイクルへ。潰すかどうかは任意です。

overrides.note: Rinse before recycling. Remove caps if they are a different material.
overrides.note_ja: 中を洗ってからリサイクルへ。素材の異なるキャップは外してください。

overrides.note: Cling wrap and plastic film are not recyclable in most curbside programs.
overrides.note_ja: ラップやフィルムはほとんどのリサイクルプログラムで回収できません。

overrides.note: Most takeout containers are mixed materials or food-soiled. Check if the container is marked compostable.
overrides.note_ja: テイクアウト容器は複合素材や食品汚れが多いです。コンポスト対応マークを確認してください。

overrides.note: Flatten cardboard boxes. Remove tape and labels if possible.
overrides.note_ja: 段ボールは潰してください。テープやラベルはできるだけ剥がしてください。

overrides.note: All fruit and vegetable scraps are compostable.
overrides.note_ja: 果物や野菜くずはすべてコンポスト可能です。

overrides.note: All fruit and vegetable scraps are compostable.
overrides.note_ja: 果物や野菜くずはすべてコンポスト可能です。

overrides.note: Chip bags are made of mixed materials (plastic and metal foil) and are not recyclable.
overrides.note_ja: スナック袋はプラスチックとアルミの複合素材のためリサイクルできません。

overrides.note: Plastic straws are too small and light for recycling machinery.
overrides.note_ja: プラスチックストローは小さすぎてリサイクル機械で処理できません。

overrides.note: Plastic utensils are not recyclable. If marked compostable (BPI-certified), they go in compost.
overrides.note_ja: プラスチック製カトラリーはリサイクル不可。BPI認証のコンポスト対応品はコンポストへ。

tips.text: Rinse containers before recycling — food residue contaminates the whole batch.
Flatten cardboard boxes so they take up less space in the recycling bin.
Plastic bags jam sorting machines. Bring them to a grocery store drop-off instead.
Paper coffee cups have a plastic lining — they go in landfill, not recycling.
When in doubt, landfill is safer than contaminating the recycling stream.
Remove caps and lids before recycling bottles — they are often a different material.
Pizza boxes with grease stains go in landfill — grease contaminates both recycling and compost.
Batteries and electronics need special disposal — never put them in regular bins.
